canoe.en: We rented a canoe and paddled slowly across the quiet lake.
canoe.zh: 我們租了一艘獨木舟，慢慢划過平靜的湖面。

canvas.en: The artist stretched a clean canvas across the wooden frame.
canvas.zh: 藝術家把乾淨的畫布繃在木框上。

canyon.en: The river carved a deep canyon through the rocky landscape.
canyon.zh: 河流在岩石地形中切割出一道深峽谷。

cap.en: He wore a blue cap to protect his face from sunlight.
cap.zh: 他戴著藍色帽子，避免陽光直射臉部。

capability.en: The new software has the capability to process large data sets quickly.
capability.zh: 這套新軟體具備快速處理大型資料集的能力。

cape.en: Strong winds swept across the cape beside the open sea.
cape.zh: 強風吹過臨近外海的岬角。

capitalism.en: The class compared capitalism with several other economic systems.
capitalism.zh: 全班比較資本主義與其他幾種經濟制度。

capitalist.en: A capitalist economy usually allows private ownership of many businesses.
capitalist.zh: 資本主義經濟通常允許許多企業由私人擁有。

capsule.en: The medicine came in a small capsule that was easy to swallow.
capsule.zh: 這種藥裝在一顆容易吞嚥的小膠囊裡。

caption.en: Each photograph needs a short caption explaining what it shows.
caption.zh: 每張照片都需要一段簡短說明文字來解釋內容。

captive.en: The rescued bird was kept captive only until it recovered.
captive.zh: 獲救的鳥只在康復前暫時被圈養。

captivity.en: The animal was returned to the wild after years in captivity.
captivity.zh: 這隻動物在被圈養多年後回到野外。

carbon.en: Trees absorb carbon from the atmosphere as they grow.
carbon.zh: 樹木在生長時會從大氣中吸收碳。

cardboard.en: The students built a model bridge from thick cardboard and glue.
cardboard.zh: 學生用厚紙板和膠水做了一座模型橋。

cardinal.en: Safety is a cardinal principle in every laboratory activity.
cardinal.zh: 安全是每項實驗室活動中的重要基本原則。

carefree.en: The children enjoyed a carefree afternoon playing games in the park.
carefree.zh: 孩子們在公園玩遊戲，度過一個無憂無慮的下午。

caretaker.en: The school caretaker checks the classrooms after everyone leaves.
caretaker.zh: 學校管理員會在大家離開後檢查教室。

cargo.en: The ship carried cargo between several ports along the coast.
cargo.zh: 這艘船在沿岸幾個港口之間運送貨物。

carnival.en: The town holds a colorful carnival at the end of summer.
carnival.zh: 這座城鎮在夏末舉辦一場繽紛的嘉年華。

carpenter.en: The carpenter measured the wooden boards before cutting them carefully.
carpenter.zh: 木匠在仔細切割木板前先量好尺寸。

carpet.en: A thick carpet covered the floor of the reading room.
carpet.zh: 閱讀室的地板上鋪著一張厚地毯。

carriage.en: The museum displays an old carriage once used for local travel.
carriage.zh: 博物館展示一輛過去用於地方交通的舊馬車。

carrier.en: The airline is a major carrier serving several Asian cities.
carrier.zh: 這家航空公司是服務多個亞洲城市的主要承運業者。

carrot.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the vegetable soup.
carrot.zh: 她切了一根紅蘿蔔加入蔬菜湯中。

cart.en: The worker pushed a cart filled with books across the hallway.
cart.zh: 工作人員推著裝滿書的推車穿過走廊。

carton.en: Please place the empty carton in the recycling container.
carton.zh: 請把空紙盒放進回收容器。

cartoon.en: The cartoon explains the science idea with simple drawings and humor.
cartoon.zh: 這部卡通用簡單圖畫與幽默解釋科學概念。

carve.en: The artist used small tools to carve patterns into the wood.
carve.zh: 藝術家用小工具在木頭上雕刻圖案。

cashier.en: The cashier gave us a receipt after we paid for lunch.
cashier.zh: 我們付完午餐費後，收銀員給了收據。

casino.en: The former casino building has been converted into a public museum.
casino.zh: 原本的賭場建築已改建成公共博物館。

cast.en: The director announced the final cast for the school play.
cast.zh: 導演公布了校園戲劇的最終演員名單。

castle.en: The ancient castle stands on a hill above the river.
castle.zh: 這座古老城堡矗立在河流上方的山丘上。

casual.en: The meeting had a casual atmosphere despite the serious topic.
casual.zh: 儘管主題嚴肅，會議氣氛仍相當輕鬆。

casualty.en: Emergency planning aims to reduce every possible casualty during disasters.
casualty.zh: 緊急應變規劃旨在降低災害中的人員傷亡。

catalogue.en: The library catalogue helps students find books by title or author.
catalogue.zh: 圖書館目錄能幫助學生依書名或作者查找書籍。

catastrophe.en: Careful preparation can reduce the damage caused by a natural catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 充分準備可以降低自然災難造成的損害。

cater.en: The workshop will cater to students with different levels of experience.
cater.zh: 這場工作坊會照顧不同經驗程度學生的需求。

caterpillar.en: A green caterpillar slowly crossed the leaf in the garden.
caterpillar.zh: 一隻綠色毛毛蟲慢慢爬過花園裡的葉子。

cathedral.en: Visitors admired the cathedral for its tall windows and stone arches.
cathedral.zh: 遊客欣賞這座大教堂高聳的窗戶與石拱門。

cattle.en: The farmer moved the cattle to a field with fresh grass.
cattle.zh: 農夫把牛群移到有新鮮青草的田地。

caution.en: The teacher urged caution when students handled the glass equipment.
caution.zh: 老師提醒學生操作玻璃器材時要小心。

cave.en: The explorers entered the cave with lamps and safety helmets.
cave.zh: 探險者戴著安全帽並帶著燈進入洞穴。

cavity.en: The dentist found a small cavity during the routine examination.
cavity.zh: 牙醫在例行檢查時發現一個小蛀洞。

celebrity.en: The article examines how a celebrity can influence public attention.
celebrity.zh: 這篇文章探討名人如何影響大眾注意力。

celery.en: She chopped celery into small pieces for the salad.
celery.zh: 她把芹菜切成小塊加入沙拉。

cell.en: Each cell in the sample was examined under a microscope.
cell.zh: 樣本中的每個細胞都在顯微鏡下接受觀察。

cellphone.en: Students should silence each cellphone before the presentation begins.
cellphone.zh: 簡報開始前，學生應把每支手機調成靜音。

cellular.en: The lesson explains how cellular structures support basic life functions.
cellular.zh: 這堂課說明細胞結構如何支持基本生命功能。

celsius.en: The temperature reached thirty degrees celsius by early afternoon.
celsius.zh: 下午較早時氣溫就達到攝氏三十度。

cement.en: Workers used cement to secure the posts along the walkway.
cement.zh: 工人用水泥固定步道旁的柱子。

cemetery.en: The old cemetery contains graves from several generations of residents.
cemetery.zh: 這座老墓園有好幾代居民的墓地。

census.en: The national census collects information about population size and households.
census.zh: 全國人口普查會蒐集人口規模與家戶資料。

cent.en: The price increased by only one cent this week.
cent.zh: 這個價格本週只增加了一分錢。

centimeter.en: The plant grew nearly one centimeter during the observation period.
centimeter.zh: 這株植物在觀察期間長高了將近一公分。

ceramic.en: The museum displayed a ceramic bowl made hundreds of years ago.
ceramic.zh: 博物館展示一只數百年前製作的陶碗。

cereal.en: He ate a bowl of cereal before leaving for school.
cereal.zh: 他上學前吃了一碗早餐穀片。

certainty.en: We cannot predict the result with complete certainty yet.
certainty.zh: 我們目前還無法完全確定地預測結果。

certificate.en: Each participant received a certificate after completing the training course.
certificate.zh: 每位參與者完成訓練課程後都收到一張證書。

certify.en: An independent inspector will certify that the equipment meets safety standards.
certify.zh: 獨立檢查員會證明設備符合安全標準。

chain.en: A long chain connected the gate to the metal post.
chain.zh: 一條長鏈條把大門連接到金屬柱上。

chairperson.en: The chairperson opened the meeting and introduced the first speaker.
chairperson.zh: 主席宣布會議開始並介紹第一位講者。

chairwoman.en: The chairwoman invited each member to share a brief opinion.
chairwoman.zh: 女主席邀請每位成員簡短分享意見。

chalk.en: The teacher used chalk to draw a diagram on the board.
chalk.zh: 老師用粉筆在黑板上畫了一張圖。

chamber.en: The experiment took place inside a sealed chamber with controlled temperature.
chamber.zh: 實驗在一個可控制溫度的密閉室內進行。

champion.en: The defending champion trained carefully before the final competition.
champion.zh: 衛冕冠軍在決賽前認真訓練。

championship.en: Our school team reached the championship after winning five matches.
championship.zh: 校隊贏得五場比賽後晉級冠軍賽。

chant.en: The crowd began a cheerful chant during the school sports event.
chant.zh: 群眾在校內運動活動中開始歡樂地齊聲呼喊。

chaos.en: Clear instructions prevented chaos when everyone left the building.
chaos.zh: 清楚的指示避免大家離開建築物時陷入混亂。

chapel.en: The small chapel is known for its stained glass windows.
chapel.zh: 這座小教堂以彩繪玻璃窗聞名。

characterize.en: Researchers characterize the region as warm, humid, and biologically diverse.
characterize.zh: 研究人員把這個地區描述為溫暖、潮濕且生物多樣。

charitable.en: The club organized a charitable event to support local families.
charitable.zh: 社團舉辦慈善活動來協助當地家庭。

charity.en: Students collected books for a charity that supports young readers.
charity.zh: 學生為支持年輕讀者的慈善機構募集書籍。

charm.en: The old neighborhood has a quiet charm that attracts visitors.
charm.zh: 這個老社區有一種吸引遊客的寧靜魅力。

chase.en: The puppy began to chase a ball across the yard.
chase.zh: 小狗開始在院子裡追著球跑。

chat.en: We had a short chat before the afternoon class began.
chat.zh: 下午課開始前，我們簡短聊了一下。

cheap.en: A cheap option can still be reliable if you compare the features carefully.
cheap.zh: 如果仔細比較功能，便宜的選項仍然可能很可靠。

cheat.en: Students should never cheat because learning depends on honest effort.
cheat.zh: 學生不應作弊，因為學習有賴誠實的努力。

checkup.en: The doctor recommended a regular checkup to monitor overall health.
checkup.zh: 醫師建議定期健康檢查以追蹤整體健康狀況。

cheek.en: A cold breeze touched her cheek as she opened the window.
cheek.zh: 她打開窗戶時，一陣冷風拂過她的臉頰。

cheerful.en: Her cheerful voice helped the group feel more relaxed before presenting.
cheerful.zh: 她開朗的聲音讓小組在簡報前更加放鬆。

cheese.en: He added a slice of cheese to the warm sandwich.
cheese.zh: 他在熱三明治裡加了一片起司。

chef.en: The chef explained how fresh ingredients affect the final flavor.
chef.zh: 主廚解釋新鮮食材如何影響最後的味道。

chemist.en: The chemist tested several samples before writing the final report.
chemist.zh: 化學家測試了多個樣本後才撰寫最終報告。

cherish.en: Many graduates cherish the friendships they formed during high school.
cherish.zh: 許多畢業生珍惜高中時建立的友誼。

cherry.en: A ripe cherry fell from the tree onto the grass.
cherry.zh: 一顆成熟的櫻桃從樹上掉到草地。

chess.en: Playing chess can help students practice planning several moves ahead.
chess.zh: 下棋可以幫助學生練習提前規劃好幾步。

chest.en: The old wooden chest contained letters, photographs, and family records.
chest.zh: 這只老木箱裡放著信件、照片與家族紀錄。

chestnut.en: We found a chestnut beneath the trees beside the trail.
chestnut.zh: 我們在步道旁的樹下發現一顆栗子。

chew.en: Take time to chew your food slowly before swallowing it.
chew.zh: 吞嚥前要花時間慢慢咀嚼食物。

chief.en: The chief concern in the experiment was keeping the temperature stable.
chief.zh: 這項實驗最主要的考量是維持溫度穩定。

childhood.en: The photograph reminded her of a favorite place from childhood.
childhood.zh: 這張照片讓她想起童年時最喜歡的一個地方。

chimney.en: Smoke rose from the chimney on the cold winter morning.
chimney.zh: 寒冷冬日早晨，煙從煙囪升起。

chimpanzee.en: The documentary follows a chimpanzee living in a protected forest.
chimpanzee.zh: 這部紀錄片追蹤一隻住在保護森林裡的黑猩猩。

chin.en: He rested his chin on his hand while reading the article.
chin.zh: 他閱讀文章時把下巴靠在手上。

chip.en: A tiny chip in the glass made the cup unsafe to use.
chip.zh: 玻璃上的小缺口讓這個杯子不適合繼續使用。

chocolate.en: She shared a piece of chocolate with her classmate after lunch.
chocolate.zh: 午餐後，她和同學分享了一塊巧克力。

choir.en: The school choir practiced every week before the winter concert.
choir.zh: 學校合唱團在冬季音樂會前每週練習。

chop.en: Please chop the vegetables into small pieces before cooking them.
chop.zh: 烹煮前請把蔬菜切成小塊。

chopstick.en: He used a chopstick to point at the model without touching it.
chopstick.zh: 他用一根筷子指向模型，避免直接碰觸。

chorus.en: Everyone joined the chorus during the final part of the song.
chorus.zh: 歌曲最後一段時，大家都加入副歌合唱。

Christian.en: The article describes a Christian community and its local traditions.
Christian.zh: 這篇文章描述一個基督教社群及其地方傳統。

Christianity.en: The course introduces Christianity as one of several major world religions.
Christianity.zh: 這門課將基督教介紹為世界主要宗教之一。

cigarette.en: The health poster explains why cigarette smoke can harm nearby people.
cigarette.zh: 健康海報說明香菸煙霧為何可能傷害周遭的人。

cinema.en: The old cinema now hosts films, talks, and community events.
cinema.zh: 這間老電影院現在舉辦電影放映、講座與社區活動。

circulation.en: Regular exercise can improve blood circulation throughout the body.
circulation.zh: 規律運動可以改善全身的血液循環。

circus.en: The history exhibit explains how the traveling circus changed over time.
circus.zh: 歷史展覽說明巡迴馬戲團如何隨時間改變。

citation.en: Every quotation in the report should include a proper citation.
citation.zh: 報告中的每段引文都應附上適當的引用來源。

civilian.en: The museum records how civilian life changed during the conflict.
civilian.zh: 博物館記錄衝突期間平民生活如何改變。

civilization.en: The river supported the growth of an ancient civilization for centuries.
civilization.zh: 這條河流數百年來支持一個古老文明的發展。

clap.en: The audience began to clap when the final speaker finished.
clap.zh: 最後一位講者結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

clarity.en: The editor revised the paragraph to improve its clarity and flow.
clarity.zh: 編輯修改這段文字，以提升清楚度與流暢度。

clash.en: The two events clash, so students must choose one to attend.
clash.zh: 兩場活動時間衝突，因此學生必須選一場參加。

classic.en: The library displayed a classic novel beside several modern works.
classic.zh: 圖書館把一部經典小說放在幾本現代作品旁展示。

classification.en: The classification system groups the samples by size and material.
classification.zh: 這套分類系統依大小與材質將樣本分組。

classify.en: Students classify the rocks according to color, texture, and hardness.
classify.zh: 學生依顏色、質地與硬度分類岩石。

classroom.en: The classroom became quiet as soon as the test began.
classroom.zh: 測驗一開始，教室就安靜下來。

clause.en: This clause explains when the agreement can be changed.
clause.zh: 這個條款說明在何種情況下可以修改協議。

claw.en: The bird used its claw to hold the branch firmly.
claw.zh: 那隻鳥用爪子牢牢抓住樹枝。

clay.en: Students shaped wet clay into small bowls during art class.
clay.zh: 學生在美術課把濕黏土塑成小碗。

cleaner.en: The cleaner finished the hallway before students arrived in the morning.
cleaner.zh: 清潔人員在早上學生到校前完成走廊清潔。

clearance.en: The truck needs enough clearance to pass safely under the bridge.
clearance.zh: 卡車需要足夠淨空才能安全通過橋下。

cliff.en: A safety fence keeps visitors away from the edge of the cliff.
cliff.zh: 安全圍欄讓遊客遠離懸崖邊緣。

climax.en: The story reaches its climax near the end of the final chapter.
climax.zh: 故事在最後一章接近結尾時達到高潮。

cling.en: Wet leaves cling to the sidewalk after a heavy rain.
cling.zh: 大雨過後，濕葉子黏在行人道上。

clinic.en: The school clinic provides basic care for students who feel unwell.
clinic.zh: 學校保健室為身體不適的學生提供基本照護。

clinical.en: The article summarizes clinical research without giving personal medical advice.
clinical.zh: 這篇文章整理臨床研究，但不提供個人醫療建議。

clip.en: She used a clip to keep the papers together during class.
clip.zh: 她用夾子把課堂上的文件夾在一起。

clockwise.en: Turn the handle clockwise until the lid is firmly closed.
clockwise.zh: 順時針轉動把手，直到蓋子牢牢關緊。

clone.en: The lesson discusses how scientists define a biological clone.
clone.zh: 這堂課討論科學家如何定義生物學上的複製個體。

closet.en: The sports equipment is stored in a closet beside the gym.
closet.zh: 運動器材存放在體育館旁的儲藏櫃裡。

closure.en: The road closure forced buses to use a different route.
closure.zh: 道路封閉迫使公車改走不同路線。

clothe.en: The organization works to clothe families who need basic supplies.
clothe.zh: 這個組織協助有需要的家庭取得基本衣物。

clothing.en: Warm clothing is important when hiking in cold mountain weather.
clothing.zh: 在寒冷山區健行時，保暖衣物很重要。

cloudy.en: The sky remained cloudy throughout most of the afternoon.
cloudy.zh: 整個下午大部分時間天空都維持多雲。

clown.en: A clown entertained children at the community festival with simple tricks.
clown.zh: 一名小丑在社區節慶用簡單把戲逗孩子開心。

clue.en: The final clue helped the students solve the classroom puzzle.
clue.zh: 最後一個線索幫助學生解開教室謎題。

clumsy.en: The clumsy robot dropped the block during its first test.
clumsy.zh: 那台笨拙的機器人在第一次測試時掉下積木。

cluster.en: A cluster of stars appeared clearly in the night sky.
cluster.zh: 夜空中清楚出現一群聚集的星星。

coalition.en: Several groups formed a coalition to support the environmental project.
coalition.zh: 數個團體組成聯盟支持這項環境計畫。

coarse.en: The coarse surface felt rough compared with the polished sample.
coarse.zh: 這個粗糙表面與拋光樣本相比摸起來很不平滑。

coastline.en: The map shows how the coastline changed after years of erosion.
coastline.zh: 地圖顯示海岸線在多年侵蝕後如何改變。

cockroach.en: A cockroach appeared near the sink, so the area was cleaned.
cockroach.zh: 水槽附近出現一隻蟑螂，因此該區域被清理。

cocoa.en: She mixed cocoa with warm milk for the winter drink.
cocoa.zh: 她把可可和溫牛奶混合成冬季飲品。

coconut.en: The recipe uses coconut to add a mild tropical flavor.
coconut.zh: 這份食譜用椰子增添淡淡的熱帶風味。

cognitive.en: Sleep can influence cognitive performance such as attention and memory.
cognitive.zh: 睡眠可能影響注意力與記憶等認知表現。

coincidence.en: It was a coincidence that both groups chose the same topic.
coincidence.zh: 兩組剛好選到相同主題只是一個巧合。

collaboration.en: The project succeeded because of close collaboration between three classes.
collaboration.zh: 這項專題因三個班級密切合作而成功。

collar.en: The dog wore a bright collar with its name attached.
collar.zh: 那隻狗戴著一個附有名字的亮色項圈。

colleague.en: She asked a colleague to review the report before publication.
colleague.zh: 她請一位同事在出版前審閱報告。

collector.en: The collector donated several rare postcards to the local museum.
collector.zh: 這位收藏家捐了幾張稀有明信片給地方博物館。

collision.en: The safety system helps reduce the risk of a collision.
collision.zh: 這套安全系統有助於降低碰撞風險。

colloquial.en: The teacher explained that the phrase is common in colloquial English.
colloquial.zh: 老師解釋這個片語在口語英文中很常見。

colonial.en: The museum examines buildings from the region's colonial period.
colonial.zh: 博物館研究這個地區殖民時期的建築。

colony.en: The scientists observed a colony of birds nesting on the island.
colony.zh: 科學家觀察島上一群築巢的鳥類群落。

colorful.en: The market was filled with colorful signs, fruit, and flowers.
colorful.zh: 市場裡充滿繽紛的招牌、水果與花朵。

columnist.en: The columnist writes a weekly article about education and technology.
columnist.zh: 這位專欄作家每週撰寫教育與科技文章。
